incident: Publication shell succeeded in push and exact ls-remote, then git status received SIGXFSZ (153) because the worker applied the 128KiB capture cap as RLIMIT_FSIZE to all files, including Git optional index refresh.
resolution: Removed incomplete owned lock only after command termination; GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 status succeeds, clean checkout. Git status optional refresh is not needed. Publication already verified; no push retry. Mandatory 24MiB individual file / 128KiB output guards remain.
